description: Known cross-platform drift for android (A9.2: recorded, not changed, in this program). `expectations` maps each expectations file (by name) and case file to text that names every field that differs, as "field: why". A conformance test passes a case when android matches `expected`, or differs only in a field its entry names; the entry is removed in the change that fixes the drift. `other` records verified drift no expectations case pins. Only the android unit edits this file.

other.flags.fraction: RemoteValues.isOn and isNotOff (MOBILE_HOUSE_AD_ENABLED, MOBILE_AD_MUTE_AUTOPLAY, VIDEO_*, NATIVE_*, GROWTHCODE_*) read a number with toInt(), so a fraction such as 0.5 reads as 0: off for the default-on flags and never on for the default-off ones. The app-config schema's flag says only 0 is off. EVENTS_ENABLED no longer drifts (it uses coerceFlag since phase 3). No expectations case pins a fraction; RemoteValuesTest does.
other.flags.text: RemoteValues.isOn (the default-off VIDEO_*, NATIVE_*, GROWTHCODE_* flags, GROWTHCODE_SEND_MAID once set) reads text as on only for 1/true/yes/on in any case, as core's growthcode truthy() does, so text such as "enabled" is off. The app-config schema's flag says only false/0/no/off text is off. No expectations case pins it; SellwildGrowthCodeTest does.
